answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 22905 Country: India Title: I work in a Software department (IT) in Pune. The company i work for has a business if Insurance in US. I want to know if my earning is Valid (Halaal)? Question: I work in a Software department (IT) in Pune. The company i work for has a business if Insurance in US. I want to know if my earning is Valid (Halaal)? Answer ID: 22905 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1131/921/B=1431) We cannot say anything in this regard until the whole published procedure (in Urdu) of this company is not before us. However insurance policy contains interest and gambling i.e. it consists of both these things. The illegality of these two is proved by the holy Quran. Hence Muslims should not involve in insurance at any cost. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
